title: Owned components of an IBM client platform through two releases
summary: I became component owner for the Lotus Expeditor toolkit and drove two releases out with the defect count brought close to zero.
what_would_have_happened: Toolkit releases would have shipped carrying open defects and without a clear owner for their components.
the_call: Own the components end to end: requirements, features, fixes, docs and forum support.
what_i_did: Implemented features, fixed defects, wrote tests and documentation, and answered customer questions in internal and external forums.
what_changed: Delivered toolkit v6.2.1 and v6.2.2 with the defect count at virtually zero, and led parts of v6.2.3.
